selection_rationale: A gun-line core: two battleships and two battlecruisers carry four spinal coilers plus heavy batteries, with two frigates adding PD to anchor a 14-turret defensive wall against torpedo saturation. Head-on closure favors kinetic impact scaling and keeps the fleet in a single cohesive speed band (1-1.5g), so no hull is abandoned.
formation_rationale: Battleships form the forward vanguard and absorb the first exchange. Battlecruisers sit 60 km behind in a second line, while frigates occupy the center as close PD escorts. The entire formation stays within ~100 km pairwise so PD coverage overlaps, with modest lateral and vertical offsets to complicate enemy spinal aiming without diluting the screen.
